name: @timon-ai/growth-studio
description: Timon plugin: write, validate, schedule and publish social posts with an agent of your choice.

timon.label: Growth Studio
timon.description: Growth Studio: queue of drafts, validation, automatic scheduling, calendar, triage of watched content and publishing at the planned time, with an agent of your choice.
timon.author: Timon

settings.label: Data source: plugin (the plugin's own database) or legacy (an existing project database, during the transition)
Legacy mode only: absolute path of the project's growth.db (empty = the project this package was installed from)
Database backups to keep: before each update of its database the plugin saves a copy (growth.db.bak-v<version>-<date> in its storage folder) and keeps this many
Agent: the Timon agent that writes for the studio (drafts, rewrites, visuals, ideas). Required: the studio starts no mission until it is set

Command the agent runs the studio tools with (Node.js 22.5 or newer): empty = the runtime running Timon; set it (e.g. node, or an absolute path) when the agent check of the Set up cannot reach the studio
Fetch X bookmarks in the studio (job): first page every few minutes, then one triage mission at a time. Leave off while another tool still fetches them
Watch followed accounts in the studio (job): polls due accounts through treg, detects news of breaking accounts and starts the news drafts. Leave off while another tool still polls them

Weekly synthesis of the feedback in the studio (job): once a week, one mission turns the user's recurring feedback into rule proposals to accept or refuse in Settings › Learning. Leave off while another tool still runs it

Search posts for the prospecting comment campaigns in the studio (job): searches the queries of the active campaigns through treg, sets aside the authors affiliated with a competitor, then one qualification mission at a time. Leave off while another tool still searches them
treg connector: cli (the treg command with the `treg login` session of the user running Timon) or http (treg API with a key, see below)
treg http mode: API address (its host must be in pluginPolicy.http.allow)
treg http mode: API key typed here (wins over the vault secret below)
treg http mode: name of the vault secret holding the treg API key, granted to agent:plugin:growth-studio
GetXAPI key typed here (bookmarks, media upload, quotes; wins over the vault secret below)
Name of the vault secret holding the GetXAPI key, granted to agent:plugin:growth-studio (the x.com cookie of each account is set in the account's Publishing tab)

Headless browser that renders coded visuals (name or absolute path, allowed in pluginPolicy.exec.allow); empty = google-chrome, chromium… whichever is allowed. Without one, the agent renders the page itself
When a rule for all accounts is accepted, also have the agent record it in its Timon memory
